Judy Greer provides the speaking voice for the character, who first appeared in the series' pilot episode "Mole Hunt" on January 17, 2010, while Jessy Lynn Martens provides the singing voice for the character when she turns into country star Cherlene in season 5.  Conceived and devised by "Archer" creator Adam Reed, Cheryl was initially intended to serve only as a minor character for the series.
